name: Import custom objects (bulk)
summary: Import a large CSV/TSV/SSV file of custom object records (insert or update). Upload the file, watch the job, then open the failures/warnings file if any rows had problems.
whenToUse: Loading or updating many custom object records at once. The first row must be a header of REST API field names that match the object's definition.
notes: File must be under 10 MB and start with a header row of REST API names for this object.
All header names must be valid API names for the object (see 'Describe custom object' in the Custom Objects group).
The job runs asynchronously; check back in a few seconds/minutes.
After completion, open 'Failures' and/or 'Warnings' to see exactly which rows had issues and why.

form.name: apiName
form.label: Custom object API name
form.hint: e.g. car_c — find it in the 'Custom Objects' group (List custom objects).

form.name: file
form.label: Object data file
form.hint: CSV/TSV/SSV under 10 MB. First row = REST API names for this object.
